title: TacticalRock101
text: TacticalRock101 43rd President of nUSA (NARA roster) In office 21 November 2021 – 11 January 2022 [ 1 ] Preceded by Cyxlinder Succeeded by hopp_fr 47th President of nUSA (NARA roster) In office 30 October 2022 – 15 July 2023 [ 1 ] Preceded by Jtport Succeeded by UnitedGPT NARA Presidential Records roster TacticalRock101 was listed by the nUSA Presidential Records board as both its 43rd and 47th president. The Federal Election Commission certified him as the Independent winner of the Fall 2021 election, with hopp_fr as vice-president-elect, and a November 21 Discord notice announced his inauguration. A second set of executive orders signed in 2022–2023 documents policies during his later presidency, including a standard for National Security Threat declarations, furloughs of federal agencies, and the return of the Federal Protective Service to active status. [ 2 ] First presidency The Fall 2021 ballot included TacticalRock101 and hopp_fr as an Independent ticket. The FEC's certified results reported 304 ballots, 47 disqualified for alternate-account use or failure to meet voting requirements, and declared TacticalRock101 President-elect. It named hopp_fr as vice-President-elect and scheduled both inaugurations for November 21. A Discord announcement on that date said TacticalRock101 had been inaugurated as President. [ 3 ] The NARA roster calls him the 43rd President. The first order in the surviving second-generation series is dated November 21, 2021, and is signed by TacticalRock101 as President. A second, dated November 23, is numbered 42-001. Since those executive-order numbers do not match his roster ordinal, the order number should not be read as the count of his presidencies. [ 4 ] Executive Order 42-002 amended the Federal Recruitment Office order by allowing the President to designate which departments and agencies could participate. Executive Order 42-001 repealed an earlier centralization rule and required federal departments and several agencies to have their own internal-affairs or inspector-general entity. It also established an FBI Public Corruption Division with authority to investigate agencies and public servants, conduct internal-affairs audits, and report suspected illegal actions to the attorney general. These sources establish the directives as written, not how fully they were carried out. [ 5 ] Second presidency The NARA board separately lists TacticalRock101 as its 47th President. The first three reviewed orders bearing the 47 series document policy changes during this later period. Order 47-001, dated November 3, 2022, required motions to designate someone a National Security Threat to include clear evidence and made unsupported declarations invalid. It specified that a council member's statement alone was not acceptable evidence. [ 6 ] Order 47-002, dated November 10, 2022, furloughed eight departments or agencies, suspended any current employees, stopped activity, and paused recruitment. On January 25, 2023, Order 47-003 returned the Federal Protective Service to active status, citing increased activity in Washington, D.C. , and the unavailability of the Metropolitan Police Department team. The order's reasons are the President's stated grounds for the action. [ 7 ] The 47th-President roster card does not give term dates. He was publicly welcomed as President by 30 October 2022, and the orders document subsequent administration policy; the exact oath and departure dates remain unspecified. [ 8 ] Other offices Before his first presidency, TacticalRock101 served as Secretary of Defense under President Reset4K. An Executive Archives card states that the Senate confirmed him on March 28, 2020. In July 2025, a Presidential Inaugural Committee notice named him vice-President-elect alongside President-elect aConArtist and scheduled their inauguration for July 25. The announcement establishes the election result and planned ceremony; the reviewed excerpt does not include a separate confirmation that he took the oath that day. [ 9 ] Boulder preparations and the second administration By 30 October 2022, Speaker MasonRockefeller welcomed TacticalRock101 and GameLab as President and Vice President. Their administration entered office as government prepared for Boulder County . The transition emphasized more professional agencies and a broader range of public employment, connecting the second presidency with the year's reconstruction effort. [ 10 ] [ 11 ] On 10 November, TacticalRock101 explained the reasoning behind the agency furloughs: limited personnel and resources made it difficult to sustain every organization, and some duties could be absorbed by other agencies. The furloughs were intended to concentrate capacity before Boulder's opening, with a possible return for the suspended bodies as activity and needs changed. [ 12 ] [ 13 ] Boulder opened on 26 November. In December, Rockefeller invited the President to deliver his first State of the Union address of the administration on 19 December. The scheduled event was postponed that day. The invitation linked the administration's preparations with a parliamentary occasion for presenting its agenda, but the scheduled date should not be treated as proof that the address was delivered then. title: TacticalRummy
text: TacticalRummy is a public official whose service has included the chief justiceship, the National Archives , Group Management , election administration and public outreach. Their NARA service began on 28 February 2022. [ 1 ] NARA and Group Management TacticalRummy began as a NARA Administrator under pauljkl on 28 February 2022. Their later responsibilities included work through a change of ownership and a transition of archival coordination to AIex, followed by service as a District Court judge. [ 2 ] In July 2023, Group Management issued Memorandum #001, which named NARA and archival requirements for the legislature as separate directives. The same announcement credited TacticalRummy with creating the replacement constitution released after the “Great Reset.” [ 3 ] These records show involvement in the community’s archival and constitutional administration, while distinguishing NARA’s institutional work from Group Management’s authority. A December 2023 notice says TacticalRummy moved from probationary to full-time Group Manager with PaulJKL’s assent. In March 2024, an appointment announcement signed by TacticalRummy elevated AustinBoBoston1 from Judicial Branch Assistant Archivist to Archivist of the United States, documenting TacticalRummy’s part in announcing a later NARA leadership appointment. [ 4 ] Resignation and handoff On 11 August 2024, TacticalRummy announced an intention to step aside after approximately two and a half years with NARA, giving 28 February 2022 as their hire date. They said they would remain during a transfer of NARA assets to the incoming Group Manager and described their Group Manager service as non-permanent by design. The statement also described earlier FEC election-administration work and a role in Public Outreach; these are the author’s own career account. [ 5 ] By mid-August 2024, a transition to AIex as NARA coordinator was underway, and TacticalRummy was moving into a District Court judgeship. The precise completion date of the archival handover remains unspecified. [ 6 ] Chief justiceship and legal reform in 2022 TacticalRummy, serving as Chief Justice RummyLeroux, helped shape the judiciary's response to the 2022 reconstruction . On 14 July he announced preparations for a Federal Bar Association under the Supreme Court. The proposed system combined licensing and ethical regulation with plans for paid legal services and law firms in Boulder County. [ 7 ] He linked the association to a broader path into judicial service. Maintaining lists of qualified attorneys and developing clerkships were intended to make appointments more transparent and less dependent on political competition. Existing practitioners would not have to obtain licenses until fourteen days after publication of the first examination. The announcement remained advance notice, with the directive subject to Supreme Court revision. [ 8 ] The examination he described would have twenty questions across general law, jurisprudence, scenarios and ethics. The plan placed the Federal Bar beneath the Court while maintaining a separate Supreme Court Bar. It therefore returned to professional regulation within the judiciary after the earlier litigation rejecting executive control of attorney licensing. [ 9 ] [ 10 ] His chief justiceship also intersected with parliamentary reconstruction. In May he attended the State of the Union with associate justices AustinBoBoston1 and 0xSyns; on 28 August he administered oaths to newly elected senators before another State of the Union gathering. In October he announced his retirement effective 30 October and recommended Tony_Giordano as his successor, separating that recommendation from the appointment process itself. title: Teasoups
text: teasoups 53rd President of nUSA (NARA roster) In office 28 July 2024 (first inauguration) – 23 March 2025 [ 1 ] Preceded by saviorjoshh Succeeded by Rathuzen NARA Presidential Records roster Teasoups is listed by the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) as the 53rd President of the nUSA roleplay government, and also in a separate presidential roster card titled “54th.” A compiled presidential chronology dates the 53rd term from July 22, 2024, but contemporary Discord records contain a conflicting announcement naming a different person as the 53rd President-elect. The NARA records and attached executive orders document policies on public records, Cabinet reporting, agency policies, judicial selection, employment, funding, and federal organization. The surviving records do not explain the duplicated 54th ordinal or provide a complete certified election and succession chronology. [ 2 ] Election and first recorded administration A compiled chronology dates Teasoups's 53rd-presidency term from July 22, 2024; a separate vice-presidential list dates AlexJCabot's service under Teasoups from July 22. The reason-for-departure list marks Teasoups as incumbent, and a party-affiliation list identifies him as a Pioneer. The archived plaintext copies expose no author or revision-history metadata, and the incumbent label is stale in light of the March 2025 Rathuzen inauguration. These compilations are included as leads; the contemporary July Discord records conflict over who was the 53rd President-elect, as described below. [ 3 ] An official announcement advertised a June 29, 2024, presidential debate between Teasoups and incumbent GeorgeGodsent . A compiled presidential chronology dates Teasoups's 53rd-presidency term from July 22, 2024, while NARA's August 1 monthly update described Teasoups's inauguration as a July event. The chronology also calls Teasoups incumbent and identifies the Pioneer party, but its plain-text copy contains no author or revision-history metadata and appears stale relative to later events. The contemporaneous Discord record conflicts: on July 24, an owner-affiliated announcement identified “@blanket” as the 53rd President-elect and scheduled that inauguration for July 28. NARA's roster and July 28 executive orders identify Teasoups as President, while the separate announcement names a different person; the sources reviewed do not reconcile the discrepancy. [ 4 ] Four Federal Register orders signed by Teasoups are dated July 28, 2024. Executive Order 001 established a Federal Register under the White House Office of Policy and Administration for agency policies, weekly reports, presidential orders, and other designated material. It also directed review of pre-existing executive orders, which the President could repeal or replace. [ 5 ] Executive Order 002 required Cabinet secretaries and agency directors to send weekly reports to the White House Chief of Staff, due Saturdays at 5 p.m. Eastern time beginning July 28. It specified reporting subjects, excluded classified material, and provided for archiving and potential public release. Executive Order 003 required Cabinet departments and agencies to submit policies describing their hiring, internal operations, structure, and goals for White House review and archival publication. [ 6 ] Executive Order 004 created a five-member Judicial Selection Committee appointed by the President. The committee was to review applicants and present two candidates for each judicial vacancy to the President, who would select a nominee for Senate confirmation. Its text prescribed committee terms, procedures, and a code of conduct. [ 7 ] Further executive orders Executive Order 005, dated August 12, 2024, capped an individual's executive-branch employment at three jobs, with stated exceptions including military service and certain White House staff positions. It required agencies to audit staff and allowed a 48-hour period to comply before enforcement. [ 8 ] Executive Order 006, dated August 26, established a Federal Exchange under the Treasury Department to coordinate agency uniform funding. It specified eligibility and request procedures, including a minimum allocation of ten funds per eligible agent. Executive Order 007, dated October 2, transferred the Department of Veterans Affairs under the Department of Defense as a subdepartment and provided for a presidentially appointed Secretary of Veterans Affairs who would report to the Secretary of Defense. [ 9 ] Second-term record and ordinal discrepancy On November 10, 2024, an announcement said President Teasoups and Vice President-elect Rathuzen would be sworn in on November 23. Teasoups's Executive Order 008 is dated November 23 and describes itself as marking the beginning of “this administration's second term.” It reorganized the Department of Homeland Security as the primary authority for domestic law-enforcement oversight, created an Office of Homeland Security Investigations, and reassigned the Federal Protective Service's mission. NARA separately has a card titled “Teasoups, 54th,” created November 24, 2024, and an order card numbered “54-008.” These records establish that the archive treated this as a second-term record, but do not resolve how the 53rd and 54th labels were counted. [ 10 ] Executive Order 009, dated December 26, 2024, established the Office of Management and Budget within the Executive Office of the President and transferred the Treasury Department's functions, personnel, assets, and authorities to it. The order provided that existing Treasury regulations would continue until changed by the new office. [ 11 ] NARA's captured roster also contains a separate card titled “Rathuzen, 54th,” although Rathuzen's inauguration as President was announced in March 2025. The Teasoups and Rathuzen cards therefore both use the 54th ordinal. The cards, order numbering, and announcements do not explain whether this reflects a roster error, a repeated numbering convention, or distinct counts, and this article preserves the labels as recorded rather than choosing between them. [ 12 ] End of recorded presidential service An announcement published November 10 scheduled Teasoups and Vice President-elect Rathuzen to be sworn on November 23; the Federal Register's November 23 Executive Order 008 calls the date the start of Teasoups's second term. A later announcement set Rathuzen's presidential inauguration for March 23, 2025, and a same-day post identified Rathuzen as President and snowbleed as Vice President. These posts document a transfer of the public-facing presidency to Rathuzen, but the reviewed records do not include Teasoups's resignation, a certified election result, or an oath transcript for either transition. [ 13 ] 2024 FEC election records The FEC’s Summer 2024 result certificate names Teasoups as the winner with 388 votes and calls the office “52nd President,” although the July ballot names the Pioneer nominee as `@blanket`. The November FEC slate lists Teasoups with Rathuzen for Pioneer. The November result announcement calls `@blanket` re-elected, while its attached certificate names Teasoups and Rathuzen as the leading ticket and schedules inauguration for November 23. These records support the two election outcomes while leaving the identity mapping between the source labels and the ordinal difference with NARA’s roster for the respective sources to explain. [ 14 ] The party system remained active in 2026. The National Elections Administrator reported separate presidential primary winners for Forward and Pioneer in March. A later owner-issued update said the Spring presidential election’s initial count was under review and announced corrected final totals of Pioneer candidate Bathamza, 117, and Forward candidate warlockings, 109. The owner’s account described alleged access to live vote data and bias in filtering as the reason for the review; that explanation is attributed to the notice. In June, the FEC said the Board of Owners and interim leadership had approved official governing platforms for Forward and Pioneer. These are dated 2026 developments and do not establish uninterrupted official status between the 2024 notices and the 2026 reforms. title: Technozo
text: Technozo 31st President of nUSA In office 27 June 2020 – 21 July 2020 [ 1 ] Preceded by Reset4K Succeeded by BernardCaldwell NARA Presidential Records roster ; H.R. 3 enrolled bill, p. 1 Technozo is an American politician who served as the 31st President of nUSA from 27 June to 21 July 2020. [ 1 ] He was elected Vice President alongside Reset4K in the Winter 2020 election and succeeded him as President in June. He was succeeded by BernardCaldwell . His career has also included service as mayor of Washington, D.C. , a member of Congress, Secretary of Transportation, Speaker of the House, and an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court . [ 2 ] Presidential succession Technozo taking the oath of office at his swearing-in ceremony. Technozo ran with reset3634643 (also known as Reset4K) in the Winter 2020 election. The Federal Election Commission certified Reset4K as President-elect and Technozo as Vice President-elect on 17 February 2020. [ 3 ] Technozo was sworn in as the 38th Vice President on 21 March 2020, alongside Reset4K as the 30th President. He was also scheduled to give an inaugural address at the ceremony. [ 4 ] Technozo succeeded Reset4K as President in June 2020 and served until July. BernardCaldwell won the subsequent presidential election, which was certified on 5 July, and was inaugurated as the 32nd President on 21 July. [ 5 ] Earlier roles Technozo was appointed mayor of Washington, D.C. in February 2018 after the planned mayoral elections failed. He also entered the presidential race that May but withdrew after HHPrinceGeorge re-entered the contest. [ 6 ] Technozo served as a clan manager in 2018 and later held office as a representative, senator, and Senate majority leader. He also served as Secretary of Transportation and was Speaker of the House in July 2024. [ 7 ] Judicial service, retirement, and congressional recognition Under the name Justice Fortas, Technozo was appointed an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court by President Teasoups and sworn in on 17 August 2024. He announced his retirement on 7 October, effective 9 October 2024. [ 8 ] Congress enacted the Technozo Congressional Gold Medal Act as Public Law 100-3 in recognition of his presidential, congressional, executive, and judicial service. The act authorized a gold medal for Technozo and directed the Speaker and Senate President pro tempore to arrange its presentation. [ 9 ] Technozo was nominated again for Associate Justice in a White House letter dated 10 October 2025. The Senate approved the nomination. The date of his subsequent swearing-in and the duration of his second judicial term are uncertain. title: TheySinned
text: TheySinned 13th President of nUSA In office 21 January 2017 – 25 February 2017 [ 1 ] Preceded by SuddenRush12G Succeeded by Rapidaax NARA Presidential Records TheySinned was the 13th President of the Roblox nUSA roleplay community. He served from 21 January to 25 February 2017, succeeding SuddenRush12G and preceding Rapidaax . Before his election, he worked in federal security and intelligence roles, served in the Senate, and became known for sponsoring the impeachment of former President Zeyad567 . His brief presidency addressed employee conduct, executive staffing and planning for confrontation with Britain. [ 2 ] Career and election TheySinned worked in the Department of Homeland Security and its intelligence office before entering national politics. During SuddenRush12G 's second administration, he served as deputy secretary of Homeland Security and later as a senator. In Congress, he submitted articles of impeachment against Zeyad567. His presidential campaign promised broader access to executive employment, training programs, job creation, and a less restrictive approach to small business and development. [ 3 ] TheySinned defeated former President Jcmand in the winter 2016–17 election. The contest became a debate over continuity and change: Jcmand drew support from established political figures, while TheySinned presented himself as a challenger to the political order. Timothy Geithner, a former Vice President and senior official who had worked with Jcmand, publicly endorsed TheySinned and described the campaign's emphasis on working citizens, employment, and political participation. As a campaign endorsement, Geithner's account records one contemporary interpretation of the race rather than an official election tally. [ 4 ] British confrontation and war planning The new administration confronted renewed conflict with Britain. In an address dated 28 January, TheySinned said that Congress had overridden SuddenRush12G's veto of the Sovereignty Act on 22 January, undoing an earlier peace arrangement negotiated by SuddenRush, TimGeithner and Lumidas. He reported a British declaration of war and coalition preparations, criticized the congressional decision, and announced higher military readiness, intelligence restrictions and negotiations over war terms. These were the President's explanation of the crisis and his allocation of responsibility for it. [ 5 ] A separate executive order, dated 22 January and published the following day, created a War Commission comprising the President, Vice President, senior security and diplomatic officials, and designated military commanders. Legislative leaders and other officials held advisory places. The commission was assigned military planning, intelligence coordination, deployment advice and recommendations to Congress; the order also described the Vice President as co-commander-in-chief. The war preparations demonstrate that TheySinned's brief presidency extended beyond domestic employment policy. A final settlement of this January confrontation has not been established by the surviving records reviewed here. [ 6 ] Presidency The employee-conduct order of 30 January targeted abusive conduct in federal employment. It defined an abusive employee to include a current or former federal employee found to have engaged in conduct considered unsuitable for the executive branch, or someone declared “rogue” by a federal judge or Supreme Court justice. The order directed that such employees be placed on an executive blacklist, made the blacklist public, and required executive employees to report substantiated abuse to the Internal Affairs Department. It also exposed officials who knowingly hired blacklisted personnel to dismissal. [ 7 ] A second order, issued on 20 February, limited most executive employees to positions in two departments or agencies. It set out exceptions for employees representing a separate executive entity, military personnel, and divisions operating solely within one parent agency. Department and agency heads were required to review staffing and dismiss employees who remained in violation after the transition period. The order addressed the administration's concern that officials held multiple positions without carrying out the duties of each. [ 8 ] His administration also made appointments in the intelligence community. In January, TheySinned nominated LargeTitanic2 for director of national intelligence, following his service in Homeland Security's Office of Intelligence and Analysis. The Senate confirmed the nomination, and LargeTitanic2 thanked the President in a public statement after confirmation. TheySinned also appointed British2004 acting director of the National Security Agency while the Senate considered the appointment. [ 9 ] Resignation TheySinned resigned on 25 February 2017, after 35 days in office, for personal reasons. [ 10 ] Vice President PurgeSabre also left office, and Rapidaax succeeded him. The Homeland Security Department subsequently described the resignations of the President, Vice President, and White House chief of staff as a disruption to department operations. The Presidential Records board preserves two employment orders; a separate forum order documents the War Commission and should not be conflated with the employee-conduct order also numbered #1. title: TimGeithner
text: TimGeithner 19th President of nUSA In office 30 January 2018 – 21 July 2018 [ 1 ] Preceded by SheldonParty Succeeded by BernardCaldwell NARA Presidential Records TimGeithner (also styled Timothy Geithner ) was the 19th President of the Roblox nUSA roleplay community. He took office on 30 January 2018 after President SheldonParty resigned and served until the July presidential transition to BernardCaldwell . A former Vice President, senator, justice, defense secretary, and political writer, Geithner is also associated with a constitution adopted in September 2017 and later restored by Group Management. His presidency concentrated on preserving government records, reorganizing intelligence and national-security institutions, and defining employment and veterans' policies. [ 2 ] Earlier career and political activity Geithner held multiple federal roles before becoming President. His contemporary author biography identified service as Vice President, Supreme Court justice, secretary of defense, and senator. During SuddenRush12G 's 2016 reelection campaign, Geithner led campaign planning, drafted the 8 June announcement speech, and later became the ticket's vice-presidential candidate. He subsequently chaired the campaign of TheySinned . A December 2016 account of SuddenRush12G's administration also lists Geithner as a former White House press secretary and deputy secretary of state. [ 3 ] He was active in diplomacy and party debate. In 2016, Geithner argued that nUSA should remain in the roleplay United Nations after a conflict with the United Kingdom strained its standing there. He had earlier served briefly as deputy secretary of state during a dispute over international recognition. He later urged the Democratic Party to organize around clear policy goals. In November 2017, he endorsed LargeTitanic2 over AcidRaps in that winter's presidential contest. [ 4 ] Geithner authored a constitution adopted on 8 September 2017. It was readopted in January 2024 and May 2025, making his constitutional work influential across several later governments. [ 5 ] Accession and archival policy Geithner succeeded SheldonParty when the President and several colleagues resigned on 30 January 2018. The next day, he established a Federal Register for executive orders and scheduled earlier orders for repeal on 20 February. Selected measures were to be rewritten into a single new instrument. The surviving record does not confirm that every repeal and republication occurred on schedule. [ 6 ] His second order required cabinet members, agency directors, senior military officers, and other designated officials to preserve official documents and transfer their records through the White House chief of staff when leaving office. Near the end of his term, a separate order directed executive departments and agencies to lock and archive their Trello boards and Twitter accounts at noon on 21 July 2018 for transfer to NARA . Together, these measures made the production and preservation of records a recurring responsibility of the executive branch. [ 7 ] National security and intelligence Geithner's February national-security order specified the membership and procedure of the National Security Council . It made the President its chair, placed the Vice President and the state and defense secretaries among required attendees, identified military and intelligence advisers, and called for meetings at least every two weeks. A Principals Committee was designed to coordinate senior officials on national-security matters. [ 8 ] On 14 February, he reorganized intelligence under a director of national intelligence. The order placed the National Security Agency and Central Intelligence Agency in a central Intelligence Community, left the Federal Bureau of Investigation under the attorney general with shared intelligence oversight, dissolved several other intelligence offices, and set classification and clearance rules. A broader order signed on 20 May revised that framework: it placed the National Security Agency under Defense, made the Central Intelligence Agency report directly to the President, and expanded the National Security Council's role in reviewing covert operations. These successive orders show a change in the administration's institutional design within one term; they should not be treated as simultaneous descriptions of a single unchanged hierarchy. [ 9 ] The administration also created a National Background Investigations Bureau under the director of national intelligence. It was assigned background checks for federal hires, with a new screening system to be prepared by the intelligence director. A 6 May order dissolved the U.S. Special Forces, ended its ongoing operations, and offered personnel a transfer to another uniformed service. A complete record of those transfers has not been located. [ 10 ] Employment and veterans' affairs Geithner established an Office of Government Ethics to investigate adverse-employment complaints against executive supervisors. The office could recommend dismissal, suspension, or termination, with the President making a final decision subject to district-court appeal. In March, he limited most executive employees to two departments or agencies, while generally restricting presidential appointees and civil officers to a single post. He also sought a chair for the National Labor Dispute Board, an additional employment-review body available under law. [ 11 ] His 27 March veterans' affairs order dissolved the stand-alone Department of Veterans' Affairs and replaced it with a Veterans' Affairs Administration under the Department of Defense. It assigned the new administration job training and reemployment functions. An April order then granted registered veterans specified employment accommodations: permission to work in three executive bodies rather than the usual two, waivers from combat-related academy phases, and seven days of absence per month. The two instruments combined a departmental reorganization with individual service benefits. [ 12 ] Final days and legacy On 21 July 2018, Geithner directed the defense and state secretaries, attorney general, and national security adviser to review the possibility of a roleplay Space Force and report options and draft legislation by 1 August. The order initiated a study rather than establishing the service. BernardCaldwell succeeded Geithner the same day; the exact hour of the transfer has not been established. [ 13 ] Geithner's constitutional work remained prominent well after his presidency. In May 2025, Group Management restored his constitution and revived court precedent formed under it. Management also proposed a convention to update provisions it regarded as outdated. The intervening years had brought other constitutional arrangements, so the readoption marked a distinct change in the legal framework. title: TimidSoul
text: TimidSoul 41st President of nUSA (NARA roster) In office 29 August 2021 – 3 October 2021 [ 1 ] Preceded by LeoVinick Succeeded by Cyxlinder NARA Presidential Records roster TimidSoul is listed by the nUSA Presidential Records board as the community's 41st President. The available contemporary election record identifies him as LeoVinick's vice-presidential running mate in the 2021 Summer election and says the National Elections Administrator declared him vice-President-elect. The roster card does not give a term date, and the primary documents reviewed here do not establish when or how he entered the presidency. [ 2 ] Vice-presidential candidacy The FEC certified LeoVinick, the Republican candidate, as President-elect after the Summer 2021 election. Its July 12 results letter states that the 12th Amendment's vice-presidential submission requirement had been met on June 26 and identifies TimidSoul as the LeoVinick campaign's vice-presidential candidate. The certification declares him vice-President-elect; it does not document his subsequent oath or describe the duration of his service. [ 3 ] Presidential listing The NARA Presidential Records board gives TimidSoul the 41st ordinal, between LeoVinick (40th) and Cyxlinder (42nd). The roster card is otherwise blank. The reviewed first-party material does not provide a presidential start or end date, an inauguration notice, an account of presidential decisions, or a documented transition to the next listed officeholder. The ordinal is therefore reported as the archive's classification, while details of this presidency remain undetermined from the sources available here. title: UKR41NIAN
text: UKR41NIAN is an account in the nUSA (Roblox group) community whose recorded work includes group ownership, senior management, and decisions about the group's roleplay governance. In January 2024, founder pauljkl announced a transfer of ownership to UKR41NIAN and Dilliuss as co-owners; a later management notice was signed “Owner.” [ 1 ] Ownership transition The January 2024 transfer announcement paired UKR41NIAN with Dilliuss as successors to founder pauljkl . The notice also said that Boulder County and its associated games would be discontinued after the transfer, distinguishing the outgoing group's assets and projects from the incoming ownership's stated plans. [ 2 ] In an April 2024 owner update, UKR41NIAN described an intended development program for Washington, D.C. roleplay, including updates to DC2 and a planned DC3 launch target of the first quarter of 2025. The same post said Group Management would take a more hands-off approach to roleplay, leaving roleplayers more room to resolve in-world matters independently while management focused on community safety. [ 3 ] Group and government management In June 2024, UKR41NIAN announced that the separate Group Manager liaison positions for the judicial, executive, and legislative branches would be combined, while the NARA Group Manager position would remain separate. The same announcement appointed AdamStratton Government Group Manager and described that office as handling Group Management entities connected to the roleplay environment. [ 4 ] The archived record documents UKR41NIAN's authority through these group-level announcements; it does not establish an uninterrupted term or specify the later status of the co-ownership arrangement. The June notice signs the role as “Owner,” while the January transfer names two co-owners. [ 5 ] The April ownership update also set out a management roster for the next phase, assigning staff leads for government liaison, legal matters, public outreach, trust and safety, and development affairs. UKR41NIAN said the team would continue with one addition for Trust and Safety and described the named staff as the team that would carry the approach forward. [ 6 ] Criminal roleplay In March 2024, UKR41NIAN announced the launch of a “Criminal Underground” group intended to give registered gangs an official place in nUSA's criminal roleplay setting. The announcement made membership conditional on belonging to a registered organization and described monetary and safehouse perks as possibilities still under development, rather than benefits that were already available. [ 7 ] This project sat alongside the owner’s broader statements about allowing roleplayers to manage in-world affairs with less Group Management intervention. In the April strategy post, that hands-off position was paired with a stated responsibility to maintain a safe community; the criminal organization announcement shows a separate effort to define structured participation within one roleplay area. title: United States Congress (nUSA)
text: Legislative institution in the municipal government The United States Congress is the bicameral federal legislature, comprising the Senate and House of Representatives . Its work includes legislation, nominations, treaties, impeachment proceedings and constitutional amendments. [ 1 ] Organization and work Congressional business proceeds through the separate chambers and their committees. Measures can await committee consideration, floor votes or presidential action; proposals, active laws, repealed measures and failed items have different legal and procedural statuses. The presence of a proposal in congressional business does not make it law. [ 2 ] The chambers exercise distinct responsibilities. In November 2017, the House rejected a proposed declaration of war following a North Korean threat against the Capitol. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Institutional changes On 15 July 2023, the Great Reset voided existing federal laws, case precedent, congressional resolutions, motions and awards. Colorado criminal law and the United States Code were designated to apply during the interim. [ 5 ] On 17 July, Memorandum 001 established archival requirements, legislative regulations and restrictions on legislation alongside a new Constitution. New NARA and Congress records systems accompanied the authorization to resume normal business under the directives. [ 6 ] The ninety-eighth Congress began on 19 August 2024. NARA required bills to carry correct session labels for archival inclusion. The constitutional framework has changed through successive versions, discussed in Constitutions of nUSA , 2024 Constitution of nUSA and 2025 constitutional readoption in nUSA . [ 7 ] Records Congress maintains records of legislative business separately from each chamber's leadership, membership, committees and rules. NARA's preservation requirements make recordkeeping part of parliamentary administration, supporting the continuity of the legislature's institutional history. [ 8 ] Constitutional conflict and reconstruction Congress's dealings with the judiciary in 2019 revealed the limits of its institutional power. The Supreme Court struck the principal provisions creating the State of Columbia because the legislatures of Washington and Las Vegas had not consented to their union. It later invalidated three of the four articles used to remove President Procursive , while leaving his removal intact. In July it also struck S. 147, which had assigned attorney licensing to executive administration. [ 9 ] [ 10 ] [ 11 ] During the 2022 reconstruction , Congress became a forum for reconsidering both the governing framework and the practical operation of public service. On 25 April it entered a constitutional convention after adopting concurrent resolutions and obtaining Supreme Court consent. In July it passed the Domestic Protection Act , distinguishing foreign citizenship from service in a foreign civil office. [ 12 ] The Federal Election Commission's interim schedule renewed both chambers through temporary arrangements of sixteen representatives and ten senators. In November the House adopted new standing rules covering leadership, committees, conduct and legislative procedure. Together, the electoral and procedural reforms sought to restore the legislature's capacity to conduct business as well as the occupancy of its seats. title: UnitedGPT
text: UnitedGPT 48th President of nUSA (NARA roster) In office 15 July 2023 – 10 December 2023 [ 1 ] Preceded by TacticalRock101 Succeeded by Akacoolguy96 NARA Presidential Records roster UnitedGPT was the 48th President of the United States in the nUSA roleplay community. Records attributed to his administration include executive orders addressing federal-agency staffing, armed-services equality, the Executive Office of the President, military force against the Konni organization, and a temporary presidential transfer under the Twenty-fifth Amendment. The President of the United States described here is a community roleplay office, not the real-world U.S. presidency. [ 2 ] Presidency The NARA Presidential Records board has a card naming UnitedGPT as the 48th President. An executive order dated July 27, 2023, is signed by “Unitedjkl,” while later orders identify the signer as UnitedGPT; the source archive does not explain the handle variation. The Winter 2023 Federal Election Commission announcement named Akacoolguy96GPT and Robbiebeastpro90000 President- and vice-President-elect on December 5. A separate December 10 announcement invited members to that evening’s presidential inauguration, marking the transfer to the next administration. [ 3 ] Executive orders On July 27, 2023, UnitedGPT ordered an immediate furlough and hiring halt for nine listed federal departments or agencies: the Defense Force Protection Agency, National Security Agency, Bureau of Prisons, Special Forces, Diplomatic Security Services, Department of Veterans Affairs, Federal Protective Services, NASA, and the Treasury Department. The order framed the measure as a response to agencies being left without sufficient need in the community. [ 4 ] An order dated October 19, 2023, established the President’s Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services. It described equal treatment and opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, or national origin as presidential policy; created a seven-member advisory committee appointed by the President; and authorized it to review armed-services rules and practices and recommend changes. [ 5 ] Also dated October 19, 2023, Executive Order 008 established an Executive Office of the President as a presidential advisory and management hub. The order made the White House Chief of Staff its head, appointed by the President, and assigned the office coordination, policy-advice, implementation-monitoring, and resource-management duties. On October 21, Executive Order 009 invoked presidential authority under the War Powers Resolution of 1973 and authorized use of military force against the organization identified as “Konni.” [ 6 ] In Executive Order 010, UnitedGPT announced a prolonged leave of absence and invoked the Twenty-fifth Amendment while a vice-presidential nominee, RickVicario, was awaiting a congressional vote. The text temporarily placed presidential powers with the Speaker of the House and said that, if RickVicario were confirmed, presidential powers would transfer to him; it also reserved UnitedGPT’s ability to resume those powers. The accessible copy does not show a date, so the order’s precise timing is not established by this document alone. [ 7 ] Later community role In February 2024, UnitedGPT announced an appointment as nUSA Community Outreach Group Manager. In his introduction, he said he had joined nUSA in 2013, held many roleplay positions, and previously served as President. He presented a 19-page set of plans and said implementation would begin during the first week; the post records the appointment and stated plans, not their subsequent completion. [ 8 ] References ↑ Nusapedia, “President of the United States” , presidential chronology, accessed 30 September 2026. ↑ “UnitedGPT, 48th,” NARA Presidential Records Trello card, https://trello.com/c/e1Uqf59N/27-unitedgpt-48th ; “UnitedGPT | 48-001 | Furlough Of Federal Departments/Agencies,” https://trello.com/c/4GBXOpIO/29-unitedgpt-48-001-furlough-of-federal-departments-agencies . ↑ “UnitedGPT | 48-001,” Executive Order #001, PDF p. 1, https://trello.com/c/4GBXOpIO/29-unitedgpt-48-001-furlough-of-federal-departments-agencies ; Discord #election-announcements, December 5, 2023, Python splitlines() lines 24362–24372; Discord #nUSA-updates, December 10, 2023, Python splitlines() lines 24453–24455. ↑ “UnitedGPT | 48-001 | Furlough Of Federal Departments/Agencies,” Executive Order #001, PDF p. 1, https://trello.com/c/4GBXOpIO/29-unitedgpt-48-001-furlough-of-federal-departments-agencies . ↑ “UnitedGPT | 48-007 | Establishment of the President’s Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services,” Executive Order 007, PDF pp. 1–2, https://trello.com/c/j3V8afxT/39-unitedgpt-48-007-establishment-of-the-presidents-committee-on-equality-of-treatment-and-opportunity-in-the-armed-services . ↑ “UnitedGPT | 48-008 | Reorganization of the Executive Office of the President,” Executive Order 008, PDF pp. 1–2, https://trello.com/c/WDmxdAYX/38-unitedgpt-48-008-reorganization-of-the-executive-office-of-the-president ; “UnitedGPT | 48-009 | Authorization of Military Force Against Konni,” Executive Order 009, PDF p. 1, https://trello.com/c/qWbMnzHo/37-unitedgpt-48-009-authorization-of-military-force-against-konni . ↑ “UnitedGPT | 48-010 | Invocation of the 25th Amendment,” UnitedGPT Executive Order 10, PDF p. 1, https://trello.com/c/g8TdOycf/36-unitedgpt-48-010-invocation-of-the-25th-amendment . ↑ Discord #nUSA-updates, February 15, 2024, Python splitlines() lines 25676–25689, including the linked “UNITEDGPT GM” document at line 25695.

title: Washington D.C.
text: Federal capital and municipal center of nUSA Washington, D.C. , also called the District of Columbia or D.C. , is the federal capital of nUSA and a center of municipal government, public employment, law enforcement, elections, and civic activity. Its history encompasses an original capital game publicized by Nightgaladeld in January 2013, a major rebuild released in December 2017, the subsequent development of the city known as DC2 , and the opening of DC3 in 2026. The city combines the institutions of the federal capital with a municipal government headed by a mayor and the District of Columbia City Council . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Washington developed alongside Las Vegas , whose casinos, businesses, and municipal institutions provided another important setting for national life. The two cities maintained separate currencies, and an attempt to unite their governments as the State of Columbia was invalidated in March 2019 because neither municipal legislature had consented. Washington's own local government was dissolved in July 2021 and later reconstituted. A January 2024 transition brought personnel from Boulder County into the capital's police and emergency services. [ 5 ] [ 6 ] [ 7 ] [ 8 ] DC3 opened in paid Early Access on 24 July 2026 and in free beta on 4 September. Its development emphasized a larger and more detailed capital, new systems, and facilities for government activity. Early public use included presidential events, in-game hiring, and testing of candidate registration and voting. As of September 2026, DC3 remained a beta with unfinished areas and continuing development; the first federal elections using its new system were scheduled for October. [ 9 ] [ 10 ] [ 11 ] [ 12 ] Names and game generations Washington's city name has remained recognizable across changes to its map, development staff, public services, and access arrangements. The original January 2013 announcements used Washington, D.C., and Washington, District of Columbia. The December 2017 rebuild was advertised as the new Washington. In April 2024, ownership explicitly distinguished the existing city as DC2 from the future DC3 project. The 2017 place was subsequently listed as Washington D.C. Legacy , while the new place was listed as Washington D.C. in September 2026. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 13 ] The principal generations are associated with different Roblox places. An asset's creation date identifies the beginning of that asset's record, while a dated announcement identifies its public presentation or opening. The first Washington asset was created on 2 January 2013 and publicly advertised by Nightgaladeld on 20 January. The later Legacy asset was created in late November 2017, immediately before the December opening. DC3's asset was created on 21 July 2026, shortly before paid Early Access. [ 14 ] Principal Washington game generations Generation Place ID Dated public milestone Later identity Original Washington 102453224 Publicized on 20 January 2013; asset created on 2 January Washington, District of Columbia December 2017 rebuild 1213026131 Released on 1 December 2017 Called DC2 by ownership in April 2024; listed as Washington D.C. Legacy in September 2026 DC3 140564898391131 Paid Early Access on 24 July 2026; free beta on 4 September Washington D.C.; continuing beta development [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 13 ] [ 14 ] [ 9 ] [ 10 ] Test areas, election centers, and council meeting places supplemented the main city. In July 2018, municipal voting used a separate D.C. Elections Center. Later testing notices directed citizens to Washington test areas to assess performance and proposed changes. Such places supported the operation and development of Washington without necessarily constituting another principal city generation. [ 15 ] [ 16 ] History Original capital and early public life, 2013–2016 Nightgaladeld publicly presented Washington on 20 January 2013. His first announcement, titled “I made Washington D.C.”, linked place 102453224. A second announcement six minutes later linked the same place and again identified it as his work. Together, the announcements established Washington as an accessible city associated with the early United States community, rather than merely a proposed capital. The underlying asset had been created earlier that month. [ 1 ] [ 14 ] Later on 20 January, Nightgaladeld advertised the United States group and its official Washington place in a recruitment notice. He offered prospective members roles in the Secret Service, Homeland Security, CIA, Capitol Police, taxi service, and White House staff, and instructed them to speak to high-ranking members about their assignments. Washington therefore connected access to a city with membership, employment, and participation in government from its earliest documented public period. The advertised jobs encompassed both protection of federal institutions and civilian services. [ 17 ] The early notices linked the same group, numbered 758071, that remained associated with the later capital games. The original Washington description subsequently listed public sites including the Washington Monument, Lincoln Memorial, World War II Memorial, and White House. That description presents the landmarks associated with the surviving place, although their exact dates of addition are uncertain. The city's continuity rests on its association with the national community and capital institutions rather than an unchanged set of buildings. [ 17 ] [ 18 ] Washington's development occurred alongside the emergence of Las Vegas . An earlier Las Vegas place was created in September 2013, and its main group-associated place was created in June 2014. Las Vegas offered a distinct city environment built principally by Pauljkl , with casinos and a substantial municipal police organization. The existence of both cities gave the community more than one setting for public employment and local government, while Washington retained its identity as the federal capital. [ 19 ] The relationship between cities and national management became contentious in June 2014. On 27 June, Verbero announced a proposed removal of Pauljkl and Las Vegas, alleged misconduct, and promised a replacement Washington city. Pauljkl disputed the allegations and requested a fuller explanation. He quoted an earlier notice that gave retaining funds within the group as a reason for the proposed separation and identified 4 July as its intended date. Bailey552 opposed the split, warning that it would harm activity in both Las Vegas and the wider community. The dispute concerned control of a major city and the distribution of community activity; the announcement alone did not establish that the proposed replacement was completed. [ 20 ] Federal policy also affected Washington's local services. During Jcmand 's administration, an order transferred local police departments in Washington and Las Vegas out of federal control. The change distinguished municipal policing from the federal agencies that operated in the same cities. Later conflicts and security alerts nevertheless brought federal personnel into Washington, making the capital a place where local police work and national security responsibilities intersected. [ 21 ] On 22 February 2016, President SuddenRush12G directed deployments to Washington and Las Vegas after briefings concerning threats from the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics. His statement raised the readiness level from DEFCON 5 to DEFCON 4 and issued a travel warning. The measures were presented as protection of American cities and citizens. Washington's significance in this episode came from its place within national security planning, not from a change of map or municipal charter. [ 22 ] Rebuilding Washington, 2017 A major rebuilding effort was publicly documented in November 2017. On 2 November, Agency_Manager sought builders for a modern Washington map for the United States group, with an offered baseline of 100,000 Robux and the possibility of a higher price. The recruitment post described the project as rebuilding the current Washington and emphasized the scale of a city and the need for buildings resembling a real place. Pauljkl participated in the discussion, encouraging the recruiter to explain the project and its requirements more clearly. [ 23 ] The recruitment offer made the rebuild a project with specific construction needs, rather than an ordinary update to a single facility. Its budget figure was an initial offer, not a final account of expenditure. The description sought modern builders capable of contributing particular buildings to a larger map. It also showed that Washington already existed and was being replaced or extensively reworked, linking the coming city to the earlier capital. [ 23 ] On 18 November, Squareheaddude announced a Washington trailer and said release was expected that month. The embedded video title credited Squareheaddude and Pauljkl. On 21 November, a further announcement set 1 December as the release date for the new Washington, District of Columbia. The release publicity included planned streams by Technozo and described the city as reborn. [ 24 ] [ 2 ] The rebuilt city was associated with place 1213026131, whose asset record began in late November. Release notices on 30 November and 1 December advertised an opening at approximately 5 p.m. Eastern Time on 1 December. Later that day, Squareheaddude asked citizens to report bugs and said he was undertaking fixes. Public access and maintenance therefore began together, with the city still receiving corrections after its opening. [ 14 ] [ 2 ] The first weeks brought both service recruitment and gameplay changes. On 9 December, Squareheaddude announced that council elections would wait until after the presidential elections, but invited applications to run the Metropolitan Police Department because the streets already required policing. On 12 December, he confirmed a fire update and new WASD vehicle controls. He promoted the vehicles as lag-free, a performance claim accompanying the announcement. The sequence placed policing, emergency response, and transport among the practical concerns of the newly opened capital. [ 25 ] [ 26 ] Elections and development, 2018–2019 The new city's municipal institutions developed after its release. A 17 February 2018 notice announced that planned mayoral elections had fallen through and that Technozo had been appointed mayor. It advertised the first councilor election for the new Washington, with eligibility including membership in the United States group and a rank of Middle Class Citizen or higher. The appointment and election were distinct steps in organizing local government. [ 27 ] On 25 February, the announced council winners were AdamCarpenterJr, IBreakingNewsI, Robbyiscrazy, ADVlCE, Dariel_Powell, LilWill_OG, SevMacLeod, and DevGralius. A separate announcement that evening linked the Washington council's laws-and-codes board. The council thus had both elected membership and a public legislative record, providing an institutional counterpart to the city's development and service administration. [ 28 ] Another municipal election cycle used a dedicated D.C. Elections Center in July. Preliminary voting opened on 27 July; the following day, the preliminary stage closed ahead of schedule and final voting began. The final ballot included council candidates and five mayoral candidates. On 1 August, the election administrator announced eight council winners and certified TheySinned as the mayoral winner after disqualifying the initial winner on stated electoral-fraud grounds. The disqualification was the administrator's finding and announcement; the certified result placed TheySinned ahead of the remaining eligible candidates. [ 15 ] [ 29 ] Development continued alongside these elections. On 19 November 2018, Squareheaddude announced a large Washington update and directed citizens to the update log. On 24 November, he advertised a forthcoming lawful trucking-delivery system. The proposed system would add work outside government and law enforcement, although the announcement did not establish its eventual implementation date. City development was therefore concerned with both public institutions and activities available to ordinary citizens. [ 30 ] Banking was another area of change. On 3 April 2019, Squareheaddude sought a new banking company to replace Capital Bank, inviting established companies and proposals for a new bank. The notice connected a commercial institution to the operation of the capital. It did not identify a successful replacement or announce when a successor opened. [ 31 ] In June 2019, a Washington development survey invited citizens to comment on hypothetical changes. Respondents were required to supply their Roblox usernames, and the notice offered three cash prizes. It expressly described the questions as hypothetical, making the survey a consultation rather than a list of confirmed changes. The exercise nevertheless gave citizens a direct route to express views about the city's future. [ 32 ] Performance improvements accompanied the expansion of public use. A 6 September test invited citizens to try Washington with a 45-player cap. Its stated priorities were reducing vehicle flinging, introducing a menu for new players, and increasing stability for larger servers. Participants were offered unlimited test money and asked to play normally. The test addressed both the behavior of existing systems and the accessibility of the city to newcomers; the announced cap was a test setting rather than a measurement of ordinary attendance. [ 16 ] State of Columbia controversy Main articles: State of Columbia (nUSA) and In re Federal Government (nUSA) Washington's municipal status became central to a constitutional dispute in March 2019. Congress's S. 127, titled To restore municipal government , sought to unite Washington and Las Vegas as the State of Columbia. It provided for a provisional governor, the exercise of interim executive and legislative authority, the negotiation of a constitution, and associated agency and court arrangements. The new jurisdiction was publicly announced on 2 March. [ 33 ] On 3 March, the Supreme Court invalidated the principal merger provisions in In re Federal Government , heard with Kirkman v. State of Columbia . Neither city's legislature had consented. The Court required clear, public, and unambiguous municipal approval and held that notice to local authorities could not substitute for consent. It struck sections 101–104 and dependent sections 106–107, including arrangements that could not operate independently of the invalid union. [ 6 ] The Court also rejected an attempt to avoid the consent requirement by treating Las Vegas as already deprived of municipal status under H.R. 179. It did not decide the validity of H.R. 179 itself, and observed that its language continued to refer to Las Vegas as a municipality. For the proposed union, both cities remained municipalities whose legislatures had to agree. The judgment preserved Washington's separate municipal position and made its council consequential in the exercise of federal power over local government. [ 6 ] Public activity and municipal dissolution, 2020–2023 Washington continued to host government and community activity while other cities experienced changing levels of participation. On 16 April 2020, management described Las Vegas as less active and less fully operational than Washington, while retaining Las Vegas's official-city status. The comparison indicated Washington's greater activity at that time without establishing a permanent closure of Las Vegas or a complete end to its public services. [ 34 ] Local executive initiatives also shaped public life. On 8 February 2021, DirectorPoke announced Municipal Order 10-0001, Free Pizza Fridays, offering D.C. citizens a free slice each Friday. A second order extended municipal protection privileges to the mayor's cabinet and incoming mayoral leadership. Further notices on 11 and 19 February invited citizens to participate, and a 12 February account described a successful gathering and linked photographs. The program was a municipal policy and public event; the same account requested that developers add pizza slices, indicating that the event's civic organization and its in-game objects were separate matters. [ 35 ] On 27 June 2021, management announced that declining municipal participation, assessed through activity and voting statistics, would lead to the discontinuation of local government. The notice set 1 July at midnight Eastern Time as the effective point, made the City Council and mayor's office defunct, and directed team-bearing services into the federal government. It also asked Congress to supply an appropriate law and left open the possibility of a limited reopening if activity improved. A follow-up on 2 July confirmed that the D.C. government had been dissolved the preceding night. [ 7 ] The affected services included MPD, EMS, the Fire Department, and the United States State Police. Their proposed transfer concerned administration of the city services, not the disappearance of Washington as a game or the erasure of its capital role. The management notice also distinguished the dissolution decision from the legislative work needed to regularize agency arrangements. [ 7 ] In November 2022, Boulder County opened as another center of municipal activity. Federal preparations for its opening included agency and legal-service changes. Washington nevertheless continued to matter in protective-service policy. On 25 January 2023, President TacticalRock101 restored the Federal Protective Service to active status, citing increased activity in Washington and the unavailability of the MPD team. The order demonstrated the use of federal protection to address a gap in municipal coverage. [ 36 ] [ 37 ] On the same date, management discussed Boulder development and identified a new District of Columbia as a future project for the development team. The statement invited suggestions while work continued on Boulder's Dentsville and federal facilities. Washington's next generation was therefore part of a wider program of city development before the explicit DC2/DC3 roadmap of 2024. [ 38 ] Return of municipal services and DC2 renewal, 2024–2025 In January 2024, a renewed Washington administration drew on personnel from Boulder County. AIex announced an agreement with Boulder governor AlexReign on 17 January, providing municipal staff with lateral-transfer routes into D.C. departments. AlexReign was designated interim mayor pending council elections. MasonRockefeller was appointed MPD chief, with the Boulder County sheriff as deputy chief and the CPD chief as assistant chief. Police staffs were directed to merge into the MPD and arrange their rank transfers through its leadership. [ 8 ] The same transition addressed emergency services. Boulder deputy fire chief peep was designated to lead Washington's Fire Department because Boulder's fire chief, InfiniteOne, also served in management. Posiedon17 was appointed EMS chief; the announcement stated that Boulder had no equivalent EMS service. The arrangements supplied the capital with leadership and a transfer process across several services instead of treating each appointment as an isolated recruitment. [ 8 ] Rockefeller subsequently announced preparations for a new police command and its first class. Officers were instructed to wait while the department organized its operations, and a Metro academy would replace FLETC in that transition. This training arrangement belonged to the 2024 reorganization; the later DC3 program again assigned a central role to FLETC. [ 39 ] [ 40 ] The January management transition also proposed investment in D.C. development, advertising, and partnerships. Management wanted more national activity to occur inside Washington: its example was a citizen entering the game, driving to the courthouse, and attending a trial at the actual facility. The plan linked city development to the operation of public institutions, while leaving individual projects to be completed through subsequent work. [ 41 ] Developer recruitment on 8 March distinguished work on the existing city from the new capital. Benda587 supervised current D.C.; chexburger supervised new D.C. scripting; and Sheev_PalpatineTGR supervised new D.C. building. The announcement primarily sought builders and modelers for the new project, while allowing less experienced applicants to join the current-city team. These responsibilities were the announced arrangement at that time and did not constitute an exhaustive final credit list. [ 42 ] On 11 March, management asserted the City Council's role in representing citizens to developers and directing development requests through local government. An accompanying declaration that a revised charter was active was withdrawn later that day. The reversal preserved the council as an advisory intermediary while allowing deliberation over the charter. It also clarified that federal institutions could still legislate or request additions and renovations. The episode exposed the overlap between municipal representation, federal law, and management control of the game. [ 43 ] The April owner update formally described parallel work on DC2 and DC3. UKR41NIAN promised refinements and substantial new content for DC2, including a crime and private-business update, while targeting the first quarter of 2025 for DC3. On 11 May 2024, SupremeFedoraa announced that the crime update was live, describing it as the largest update since 2017 and saying it had been developed in thirteen days. The release confirmed a crime update to the existing city, although the announcement did not enumerate every previously proposed business feature. [ 3 ] [ 44 ] Local elections continued during the development period. On 23 February 2025, the Federal Election Commission declared PeepGPT mayor-elect with 35.89 percent of the vote and announced council winners for the coming term. The notice expressly distinguished election from taking office, stating that PeepGPT would remain mayor-elect until sworn in. It gave 19 May as the term's expiry. Later in 2025, municipal elections were included alongside congressional contests in the Winter Election Extravaganza . [ 45 ] [ 46 ] DC3 Development and building program DC3 was developed as the next generation of Washington while the existing city continued to receive attention. The April 2024 roadmap set a Q1 2025 launch target and connected the project to efforts to rebuild the development team, restore activity, and establish a clearer direction following changes in senior leadership. The later 2026 opening occurred beyond that initial target. Development of a new city and continued support for DC2 were concurrent commitments rather than a completed handover in April 2024. [ 3 ] [ 9 ] The building program sought contributions from the institutions expected to use the capital. On 20 February 2025, AcidRaps advertised a DC3 building quality-assurance team with approximately five participants from each major field: judicial and legislative processes, enforcement, transport and parks, the private sector, and the military. The notice specifically referred to courts and town halls, agency buildings, road details, public-service buildings, and parks. Participants were to check representation of their sectors and help establish consistent standards for colors, doors, and materials across the map. [ 47 ] This review process treated city design as a set of spaces for different kinds of public activity. The aim was to avoid large differences in building quality while accommodating the practical needs of agencies and civilian organizations. The recruitment described planned review responsibilities, not a certification that every proposed facility was finished. It nevertheless gave judicial, legislative, service, commercial, and military users a place in the development process. [ 47 ] Funding was also addressed publicly. On 12 April 2025, American_Online introduced an nUSA Sponsor Discord subscription as a way to contribute to the development program. The announcement stated that sponsor revenue would support DC3 and advertising for the current game and said ownership members had personally invested thousands in the project. The funding claims were ownership's account; no total development budget was specified. Subscription benefits included communication privileges and access to the political feed. [ 48 ] Sponsor participation extended to playtesting. On 13 May 2026, Bathamza reported touring the DC3 White House earlier that week during a sponsor playtest. He praised its building style and gun system and described sponsors participating as Secret Service personnel with standardized uniforms, accessories, and weapons. He thanked CIonk_Man, Jon_Ral, and the development team, and expressed an expectation of release in July. His account documented the tested setting and credited contributors while remaining a participant's assessment of the experience. [ 49 ] Release schedule and paid Early Access On 29 April 2026, nUSA announced that DC3 would arrive in July. The announcement promoted a living open world, new systems, detailed environments, and a more ambitious recreation of Washington. These were development aims and promotional assessments accompanying a release forecast. The first specific public-access date followed on 10 July, when nUSA announced Early Access for 24 July at 8 p.m. Eastern Time. [ 50 ] [ 9 ] The July announcement expressly described Early Access as a beta. Systems and builds were to be polished, expanded, and refined before a full release. The city was presented as an opportunity to begin using the world under construction, with further work expected after players entered. The announcement therefore separated opening access from completing the development program. [ 9 ] Early Access opened on 24 July. The opening notice confirmed paid admission and said the game would become free at full release. Some systems were intentionally disabled and would be introduced over time. Mobile gameplay was available but not yet fully supported. Ownership also stated that the current experience did not represent the city's final form and invited feedback to help determine subsequent development. [ 9 ] The asset associated with DC3, place 140564898391131, was created on 21 July. Its later city description offered participation in Congress, policing, defense of the capital, bank robbery, and the presidency. The description presented public office and street activity within the same Washington environment. Its asset history identifies the new place separately from the 2017 city, while the July announcement supplies the opening milestone. [ 14 ] [ 51 ] Free beta On 30 August, ownership announced that DC3 would become free to enter on 4 September. The announcement described a larger, more detailed Washington with new systems and a foundation for continued additions. It again identified the forthcoming opening as a beta. The change broadened access from the paid Early Access stage without declaring the city finished. [ 10 ] Publicity on 3 September specified a noon Eastern Time opening on the following day. The 4 September notice confirmed that DC3 was open to everyone in free beta and thanked the original paid-access participants. It warned of bugs, unfinished areas, balance changes, and evolving features, and requested feedback. The free opening was therefore a second access milestone within ongoing development. [ 52 ] [ 10 ] The change in access also made Washington available to citizens who had not participated in the paid period. Management encouraged both long-standing members and newcomers to enter the city. Subsequent thanks emphasized participation, exploration, and feedback. These statements expressed ownership's enthusiasm for the opening; they did not supply independently measured attendance or establish a completed development stage. [ 10 ] [ 53 ] Government readiness and law enforcement The approach of DC3 affected executive administration before the public beta. On 4 July 2026, President Jsjsjbsd announced an executive order establishing a Task Force on DC3 Readiness. He described declining agency activity and a disorganized structure as problems that required attention before new citizens arrived. The task force, led by UndeadsValor, was to review departments, address inactive leadership, and prepare the executive branch for the new city. [ 54 ] The President returned to these preparations in his July public statements. His 14 July State of the Union cited the readiness task force among the administration's measures, and his 16 July post-election address described DC3 as an opportunity to revise agency operations, consolidate where necessary, and change hiring practices. These were presidential policy commitments tied to the new capital's arrival, rather than evidence that all planned organizational changes had already been completed. [ 55 ] Law-enforcement training was another preparation. On 8 August, an application notice for a FLETC director described the center as the centralized authority for training, examining, and certifying law-enforcement officers in DC3. Recruits were to attend before entering an agency. The same notice assigned FLETC a conduct-enforcement role, including revocation of licenses when misconduct was proven. This program connected police employment to training and certification, with a disciplinary mechanism extending across agencies. [ 40 ] The 2026 arrangement differed from the Metro academy announced during Washington's 2024 police transition. Training institutions changed as the capital's departments were reorganized. Their functions should therefore be understood in their respective periods: the 2024 academy prepared the reorganized municipal police, while the August 2026 announcement described a centralized DC3 law-enforcement system. [ 39 ] [ 40 ] Employment and early public administration On 4 September, Jsjsjbsd addressed the press and public to commemorate DC3's opening. He stated that USAJOBS had handled more than 500 applications and that agencies were conducting a program of official events. These figures were the president's account of administrative activity. His address connected the city's launch with recruitment and efforts to prepare departments for new participation. [ 56 ] Employment subsequently made direct use of city facilities. On 19 September, the President reported using DC3's new jobs system to interview candidates on the spot and hire two people. He said his chief of staff was adapting USAJOBS to accommodate the in-game system for departments and agencies with a team. The account identified an implemented hiring interaction rather than only a promised future feature: candidates could be interviewed in the city and hired through its system. [ 11 ] The integration of employment with buildings and agency teams gave Washington a practical role in public administration. Earlier recruitment had often directed citizens to contact leaders or submit external applications; the September account described city facilities used in the interview and hiring process. The president's statement also indicated that integration remained in progress, so the initial use did not establish that every agency had completed its transition. [ 17 ] [ 25 ] [ 11 ] Economic plans accompanied the launch. The 4 September address promised a forthcoming nUSA Stock Exchange under the Department of Commerce and Labor. A cabinet account the next day likewise described the market as forthcoming and said the military was working on new maps. These statements concerned planned additions. They did not establish an operational stock exchange or a completed new military map at the free-beta opening.
